title: 기초재고 저장 전 전체 품목 매칭 확인

criteria.rowMapping: Saved and restored baseStockMatches preserve each source row's confirmed product, name and flower context. Rebuild must not index previous rows by a lossy normalized name. Exact matching rows retain manual choices; moved rows reuse only unambiguous source identity. A missing catalog product or ambiguous row correspondence requires user review, not silent automatic replacement. Confirmed matches flow directly to applied-stock calculation and copy.
criteria.save: Save opens matching review. Every nonexcluded parsed stock row requires valid nonnegative finite quantities and a positive integer ProdKey present in current products. Invalid nonheader nonexcluded source lines block save explicitly. Zero is valid. Only 100% matching saves once automatically after review renders. Snapshot contains every matched row, exact raw text and exclusions.
criteria.scope: Pending save includes forceCreate and fingerprint of base text, base week, order week, exclusions and other persisted source texts. Scope or text edits cancel stale save. Full-year week identity remains unchanged.
criteria.failure: Cancel never writes favorites. Failure preserves mappings and shows retry. ERP/order/shipment/stock mutation APIs are never called.
criteria.keyboard: Dialog initial focus, Tab/Shift+Tab containment, Escape cancel, focus restored to invoking button. Existing product matching editor is reused. Dialog scroll is an explicit modal exception.

crossYearFixture.description: Pending 2026 stock-note save never applies after changing to 2025 even with same short week or same source.

dnspyEvidence.note: Web favorite draft only; existing ERP save SQL and native forms unchanged.
